facts.text: I am looking for a gift for my friend's birthday.
My friend's birthday is coming up in two weeks.
I want gift ideas for a 28-year-old woman.
I want to narrow the gift ideas to a budget of $50-$75.
I like the wine and cheese gift set idea.
I want specific wine and cheese pairing recommendations.
I want to customize the gift set to include a nice wine bottle stopper and a wine-themed gift bag instead of the fruit and crackers.
I want a birthday card to go with the gift.
I want the birthday card to be simple but heartfelt.
I want a card that says: "Happy birthday to an amazing friend! I hope your day is as special as you are. Here's to another year of good times and making more memories together!"
